name: Status Reason
definition: Specifies the underlying reason for the status of an object.

NoSpecifiedReason.name: No Specified Reason
NoSpecifiedReason.definition: Indicates that there is no reason available or to report.

FailingReason.name: Failing Reason
FailingReason.definition: Reason why a transaction has a failing status.

CancellationReason.name: Cancellation Reason
CancellationReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the related instruction is cancelled, or the related cancellation request is executed.

PendingReason.name: Pending Reason
PendingReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction processing is pending.

RejectionReason.name: Rejection Reason
RejectionReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction/request has a repair or rejection status.

AcknowledgedAcceptedReason.name: Acknowledged Accepted Reason
AcknowledgedAcceptedReason.definition: Specifies additional information about the processed instruction.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status for which a reason is provided.

DataSourceScheme.name: Data Source Scheme
DataSourceScheme.definition: Proprietary identification of the reason for the status.

RelatedClosureReason.name: Related Closure Reason
RelatedClosureReason.definition: Related reason of closure of the contract.
